mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checked = 1 ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart(user_id,product_id,sku_id,quantity,checked,create_time,update_time) VALUES(#{userId},#{productId},#{skuId},#{quantity},1,NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity=quantity+VALUES(quantity),checked=1,update_time=NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE cart SET checked = #{checked}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
